The '''Vadigult sector''',<ref name="Mid Rim" /> also known as the '''Va di Gult sector''',<ref name="EAOC" /> was located in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="New Territories" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The [[Gultanna system/Legends|Gultanna system]] lay within the Vadigult [[Sector/Legends|sector]] and was connected by [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] to the neighboring Mid Rim sectors.<ref name="EGtW" />

By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the Vadigult sector bordered the [[Abaar sector/Legends|Abaar sector]] westward and the [[Manoe sector/Legends|Manoe sector]] northward, and at its eastern reaches it also formed a four-way border with the [[Luuq sector/Legends|Luuq sector]] and the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region's]] [[Fellwe sector/Legends|Fellwe]] and [[Immalia sector/Legends|Immalia sectors]].<ref name="Expansion">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-expansion-region|text=Essential Atlas Extra: Expansion Region}}</ref> The sector retained these borders by [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], when it constituted a part of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="EGtW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Vadigult sector was introduced in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which listed the sector as the "Va di Gult sector."<ref name="EAOC" /> However, when the sector was depicted on a map designed by [[Modi]] and published in the [[2012]] StarWars.com article [https://web.archive.org/web/20170713024921/http://www.starwars.com/news/essential-atlas-extra-sectors-of-the-mid-rim The Essential Atlas Extra: Sectors of the Mid Rim]&mdash;which placed it in grid squares K-7, K-8, L-7, and L-8&mdash;the alternate spelling "Vadigult sector" was introduced,<ref name="Mid Rim" /> which continued to be used by all subsequent sources.<ref name="EGtW" /><ref name="Expansion" />

[[Jason Fry]], co-author of ''The Essential Atlas'', noted on the [[Jedi Council Forums]] of [[TheForce.net]] that the Gultanna [[Star system/Legends|system]] was created for "bookkeeping purposes" so that the Vadigult sector would have at least one corresponding system.<ref name="JCF">{{JCFCite|url=posts/31618818|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Atlas and Galactic Cartography: Official Discussion|user=[[Jason Fry|jasonfy]]|date=2011-03-26|time=10:52 PM|archivedate=20191013233754|quote=Of that list of systems, Gultanna, Manoe, Opitha Tren and Thory Prime were created for the appendix, basically for bookkeeping purposes so every sector would be associated with at least one system. The others are all established worlds.}}</ref>
